description: Project root marker with `compilerOptions`, file selection (`include`, `exclude`, `files`), `extends` and `references`.
Umbrella flag for the strict checks. On by default since TypeScript 6.0.
Adds `| undefined` to index access results. Not part of `strict`.
`"6.0"` silences TypeScript 6 deprecation errors until the options disappear in 7.0.
`target` decides which syntax is downleveled; `lib` decides which built-in APIs are typed.
Split large codebases into smaller projects built incrementally with `tsc --build`.
